verdict.rationale: Meltano provides the Singer SDK (EDK) framework specifically for building custom connectors for long-tail APIs, documented as first-party tooling with meltano add/init workflow, and community evidence corroborates hands-on custom tap development with a positive experience. missing for 10: independent evidence of a low-code builder UI (only SDK/code-based framework is evidenced), and more detailed hands-on walkthrough of building a connector from scratch for an unsupported API.
